data_fields.name: overloaded_total_ratio
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 x weight cap (tier 5 at excess >= 2 x cap)

best_idea: Decide stack identity from a fixed field list, refuse a pickup into a full pack only when no existing stack would take it, and roll and validate a container move before anything leaves the pack.
decision_why: Take the stack-identity key, the merge-before-slot gate, the burden tiers and the bag weight rule; reject the bag-of-holding blast as a random loot-loss mechanic (the server-verified ledger does not need random item loss); fix the donor order so nothing leaves the pack before the roll.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a potion matching a stack already in a full pack adds to that stack (count +1, no new slot), an unlike item into the same full pack is refused and the ledger is unchanged, and a multi-unit pickup stops at the last unit that keeps the total under 3 x weight cap.
